generator: Built-in image_gen tool via imagegen skill
preparation: Original generated PNGs retained unchanged. Center alpha bounds with coverage >=32 in a 64 x 64 canvas with a maximum 56-pixel visible dimension. Resize with Lanczos filtering, preserve generated alpha as white tintable RGBA8. Embedded icons use linear mipmap filtering and follow shared button ink. Cancel reuses the existing generated application prompt artwork.

icons.name: style-rename
icons.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: production desktop menu and prompt icon for Achimeld, matching its monochrome toolbar glyphs. Generate ONE flat monochrome WHITE UI glyph on a genuinely transparent background. Simple solid vector-icon appearance, balanced medium-bold visual weight, clean geometric edges and restrained large cutouts, readable at 18 pixels. Center the complete symbol in a square canvas with roughly 12 percent empty margin on every side. No text, letters, labels, badge, button body, enclosing circle, shadows, gradients, textures or decoration. Subject: one simple diagonal pencil with a clear pointed nib at lower left and a separated eraser cap at upper right, the familiar rename/edit symbol.
